analysis.insight_summary: Users experience issues sending SMS via [product_name] connected to [product_name], encountering an error that the SMS cannot be sent. Firmware updates and SIM card unlocking do not resolve the problem, suggesting that additional requirements—like activating mobile data—may not be obvious and are necessary for SMS transmission. Support indicates that an active data connection may be needed, but this is not clearly communicated in the product documentation or setup process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that updating the [product_name] and using an unlocked SIM card should allow SMS messaging without needing to troubleshoot or adjust less obvious settings.
